summary: List all known commands and the layer each resolves from.
Explain how a command resolves: the winning layer plus any shadowed definitions.

command.description: Command id to explain, e.g. remove.folder.

summary: Evaluate the active policy against a hypothetical command without running it.

command.description: The IDEL command line to evaluate.

summary: Ask the configured AI agent to propose IDEL commands through the audited runtime.

prompt.description: Natural-language request for the AI agent.

examples: ask.ai prompt="open package.json and explain the scripts"

summary: Learn draft IDEL commands from an installed CLI's help output.

cli.description: Installed CLI executable to introspect, e.g. git.

write.description: Write accepted drafts to the custom registry layer.

summary: Pause execution for a short duration before continuing.

ms.description: Milliseconds to wait. Overrides seconds when provided. Maximum 60000.

examples: create.file name=a.txt && wait.time ms=500 && read.file name=a.txt

summary: List recent audited command history, up to 1000 commands.

limit.description: Maximum commands to list. Capped at 1000.

summary: List recent OpenLog audit records for this session or user.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to list.

summary: Show the full OpenLog record for a single command by id.

id.description: The log record id to show.
